puzzles.prompt: Most abundant elements in Earth's crust
puzzles.metric: Share of the Earth's crust by mass, as a percentage.

source.name: CRC Handbook of Chemistry and Physics - abundance of elements

puzzles.ambiguity: By mass, and for the crust only. The Earth as a whole is mostly iron, and by number of atoms rather than mass the order shifts.

answers.name: Oxygen
answers.clue: Almost half the crust by mass, and bound up in nearly every rock

answers.name: Silicon
answers.clue: The basis of sand, glass and most rock-forming minerals

answers.name: Aluminium
answers.clue: The most abundant metal, and hard to smelt until the 1880s

answers.name: Iron
answers.clue: Gives rock and soil its red-brown colours

answers.name: Calcium
answers.clue: Limestone, chalk and bones

answers.name: Sodium
answers.clue: Half of common salt

answers.name: Potassium
answers.clue: Symbol K, and essential to plants

answers.name: Magnesium
answers.clue: A light structural metal, and the centre of chlorophyll

answers.name: Titanium
answers.clue: Strong and corrosion-resistant, used in aircraft and implants

answers.name: Hydrogen
answers.clue: The most abundant element in the universe, but scarce in the crust
